evidence.claim: For the Newcastle-to-Four Corners portion, begin at Newcastle’s junction of US 16 and US 85, on the southwest edge of the Black Hills.
evidence.quote: Newcastle is situated at the southwest edge of the Black Hills, at the intersection of U.S. routes 16 and 85.

evidence.claim: Cambria’s former mining town lies eight miles north of Newcastle, off US 85.
evidence.quote: Cambria was located 8 miles (13 km) north of Newcastle, just off U.S. Highway 85.

evidence.claim: Beyond it, Four Corners marks the junction of US 85 and Wyoming 585, southeast of Sundance.
